scope.user_request: Generate CryptBB datasets A and B with controller v2, then start Model1-A and Model1-B in parallel
scope.parallel_execution: Two concurrent readers, full GPU batches arbitrated by shared lock; unchanged batch128, seed48,20epochs
scope.rejection: Unvalidated controller entries block production until repaired; per-image completeness/usability/contrast and overlap checks enforced

generation.audit: decode every image, verify synthetic label metadata, zero new A/B, old A/B and real pixel overlap

training.production_gate: Actual v2 dataset checks plus paired optimizer/recovery/sampler smoke
